title: The Twins
subtitle: 考点：一般现在时 / 不同的爱好
passage: Tom and Tim are twins. They look the same, but they have different hobbies. Tom plays the guitar and Tim plays tennis. They are in the same class, Class 4. Their classmates often make mistakes about their names.
Ms. Hu, their class teacher, says, "Tom wears a red cap. Tim wears a blue one." Now everyone knows who is who.
vocab: twin 双胞胎之一 · guitar 吉他 · tennis 网球 · class teacher 班主任 · mistake 错误

questions.stem: What do Tom and Tim look like?

questions.why: Tom plays the guitar and Tim plays tennis.

questions.stem: How does Ms. Hu tell the twins apart?
questions.why: Tom wears a red cap. Tim wears a blue one.
